reviewScope.summary: Owner-authorized visual upgrade and plain-language Git & GitHub curriculum revision, M01–M07, preserving programme contracts and learner autonomy.
evidence: Inspected all seven canonical modules and generated assets, the shared Classic/RPG lesson renderer, owner reference image and approved module-by-module visual plan.

62 authored visual entries bind to existing text blocks in all 47 lessons; all anchors and graph edges resolve, no duplicate slots or new lesson steps. Nine examples have local interaction. Reusable HTML/CSS/SVG status, graph, comparison, flow, terminal, file tree, conflict, PR, command-effect and test-case displays require no new service, arbitrary markup or learner persistence.

Compared candidate assets with master: 121 existing blocks changed, all 92 command blocks are identical, 113 exercise and option identifiers, correct choices, required practice, optionality, evaluator modes and logic, skill/unit metadata and lesson order unchanged. The optional paste evaluator's only difference is its simplified privacy copy. Source and asset hashes verified during regeneration. 56 exercise hashes differ from master; historical answers retain existing semantics.
Updated the tour fixture instructions and exercise E04 to use Starttid: 10:00 on a separate line, with explicit compatibility for older exercise folders; no destructive history rewrite.

Added functional binding and visual interaction tests. Prior candidate passed browser shards and pilot; release unit stage failed only on pilot-script formatting at that point. Updated that file. Current build, lint, formatting, browser and offline validation have not been executed locally and require hosted validation.

adversarialFindings.description: Abstract Git concepts and visually undifferentiated scenarios burden beginner reading.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Add contextual diagrams, staged/unstaged status annotations, real file comparisons, commit graphs, interactive remote states, conflict markers and test case examples; shorten 34 existing prose blocks in the presentation.

adversarialFindings.description: Visual placement must not invalidate existing saved step positions or introduce an exercise gate.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Bind each visual to an existing lesson slot and matching text prefix; original prose is the fallback if the source changes. No extra lesson step, storage or scoring. Test anchor integrity against real content.

adversarialFindings.description: Revised exercise hashes may change which old responses count as current.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Preserve IDs and evaluator behavior; retain existing historical-answer semantics without migration.

retrospective.summary: Scoped implementer review PASS; no separate owner or independent review required. Hosted automated engineering checks must pass before merging or production.
